name: publish-agents
description: Reusable publication agents — browser automation and skills for Medium, cross-posting, and more.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @paladini/medium-publisher-mcp && npm run build -w @paladini/tabnews-publisher-mcp && npm run build -w @paladini/linkedin-publisher-mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @paladini/medium-publisher-mcp && npm run typecheck -w @paladini/tabnews-publisher-mcp && npm run typecheck -w @paladini/linkedin-publisher-mcp
scripts.publish:npm: npm run build && npm publish --workspace=@paladini/medium-publisher-mcp --access public && npm publish --workspace=@paladini/tabnews-publisher-mcp --access public && npm publish --workspace=@paladini/linkedin-publisher-mcp --access public
